headline: See cross-channel friction clearly without building a person-level surveillance layer.
capabilities: Consolidate interactions into a single, continuous customer view
Surface unresolved questions and journey friction instantly
Recommend the best channel and message timing for each customer
Strengthen continuity across touchpoints to deliver a consistent, connected customer experience
outcomes: Resolved issues in a single interaction with complete context
Increased conversion by delivering the right content at key moments
Improved customer satisfaction through consistent, personalized engagement
why_try: It gives experience, digital, and contact-center leaders a shared picture of continuity and friction while avoiding identity stitching and outreach.

sample_prompts.label: Compare aggregate channels
sample_prompts.prompt: As Customer Experience Leader, compare the aggregate channel picture and call out continuity risks.

sample_prompts.label: Find journey friction
sample_prompts.prompt: As Contact Center Supervisor, identify handoff friction across the aggregate journey archetypes.

sample_prompts.label: Draft consent-aware experiments
sample_prompts.prompt: As Digital Engagement Manager, propose consent-aware experiments with frequency caps and no outreach.

sample_prompts.label: Review attribution evidence
sample_prompts.prompt: As Digital Engagement Manager, summarize the synthetic attribution view and avoid causal claims.

sample_prompts.label: Contact Center Supervisor: Customer Journey
sample_prompts.prompt: Show me the customer's journey across all channels and help me pick up where they left off.

sample_prompts.label: Contact Center Supervisor: Unresolved Issues
sample_prompts.prompt: Show me what Sarah has been asking about and where we dropped the ball.

sample_prompts.label: Digital Engagement Manager: Channel Recommendation
sample_prompts.prompt: Which channel and timing should we use to reach Sarah for this issue and in the future?

sample_prompts.label: Digital Engagement Manager: Proactive Plan
sample_prompts.prompt: What proactive engagement should we plan for Sarah after this purchase, or if she doesn't convert?

sample_prompts.label: Customer Experience Leader: Handoff Package
sample_prompts.prompt: Prepare the context in case Sarah needs to be handed off to another agent.

business_flow: Customer Experience Leader, Digital Engagement Manager, and Contact Center Supervisor
Approved aggregate CRM, commerce, and contact-center analytics
